create_GameState: create a GameState to track symbolic state of an alchemy game with stones and potions
track_potion_used: record a potion use event on a stone and update the game state
track_stone_used: record a stone being placed in the cauldron and remove it from the game
replay_events: replay recorded events from a TrialTracker onto a fresh GameState to reconstruct outcomes
convert_matrix_to_action_sequence: convert a MatrixEventTracker matrix of events into an ordered action sequence list
